growth.empty.title: No numbers yet
growth.empty.body: Until the accounts are connected, numbers go in by hand: add a day's numbers, import a stats CSV, or import your posts below. Once a week is enough.
growth.empty.where: Snapchat and X have no free API, so their numbers stay manual.
growth.changed.title: This week vs last week
growth.ai.topEngagement.button: What platform drives the most engagement?
growth.ai.topEngagement.text: {platform} drives the most engagement right now: {pct} per post, from {source}.
growth.ai.topEngagement.none: No platform reports an engagement rate yet. Add a snapshot with engagement or import posts.
growth.ai.cadence.button: How often should I post on {platform}?
growth.ai.cadence.none: No {platform} posts imported for the last 30 days, so there is no rhythm to judge. Aim for 3 posts a week and import them so we can check.
growth.ai.cadence.good: {n} posts on {platform} in the last 30 days (about {perWeek} a week). The target is 3 a week: you're on pace, keep the rhythm rather than adding more.
growth.ai.cadence.low: {n} posts on {platform} in the last 30 days (about {perWeek} a week). The target is 3 a week: that's {more} more a week. Short behind-the-scenes clips count.
growth.kpi.hint: Means over the platforms with data
growth.cards.title: Platforms
growth.activity.title: Post Activity
growth.activity.note: The counters count the posts you imported under My Content (Beacons' own counters showed 0 for every platform).
growth.overview.title: {platform} Overview
growth.demo.title: {platform} Demographics
growth.demo.empty: No audience breakdown for {platform} yet. TikTok never exposes it through its API, so copy it by hand from TikTok Studio → Analytics → Followers (Instagram: Insights → Audience).
growth.demo.ageNoSplit: This reading has no split by gender; enter the male / female buckets to see it.
growth.demo.clearBody: This removes every audience breakdown of {platform}. You can enter it again later.
growth.demo.form.title: Audience breakdown by hand
growth.demo.form.hint: Copy the percentages from TikTok Studio → Analytics → Followers or Instagram Insights → Audience. Numbers only, the % sign is optional.
growth.demo.form.jsonHint: One object (or an array): platform, day, gender, age, ageByGender {male, female}, country, city. Percentages may be numbers or strings.
growth.demo.form.empty: Fill in at least one percentage.
growth.content.title: My Content
growth.content.sub: Your published posts with their numbers, imported from the platforms' exports.
growth.content.topEmpty: None of the imported posts was published in the last 7 days.
growth.content.removeBody: This removes the imported numbers of "{title}". Importing the export again brings it back.
growth.content.empty.title: No posts imported yet
growth.content.empty.body: The platform APIs aren't connected yet, so posts come in through their CSV exports: download the file, tap Import posts, and the counters, top posts and averages fill in on their own.
growth.content.empty.where: Where each export lives: TikTok Studio → Analytics → Content → Download data; Instagram → Professional dashboard → Insights → Content you shared → Export; YouTube Studio → Analytics → Advanced mode → Export current view (CSV); Beacons → Home → My Content → Download as CSV.
growth.pimport.title: Import posts
growth.pimport.hint: Pick where the file came from, then paste its lines or choose the file. The same platform and post id replaces the earlier numbers.
growth.pimport.where.mycontent: Beacons → Home → My Content → Download as CSV (has a platform column; our own Download CSV file works here too).
growth.pimport.where.tiktok: TikTok Studio → Analytics → Content → Download data: Video title, Video link, Video publish time, Total views, likes, comments, shares.
growth.pimport.where.instagram: Instagram Professional dashboard → Insights → Content you shared → Export (or Meta Business Suite → Insights → Content → Export).
growth.pimport.where.youtube: YouTube Studio → Analytics → Content → Advanced mode → Export current view → CSV (Table data). Duration decides Short vs Video.
growth.planned.title: Planned this week
growth.planned.empty: No posts planned on this platform this week.
growth.posted.title: Latest posted (calendar)
growth.posted.empty: Once you mark a post as posted in the calendar it shows up here with its link.
growth.tip.label: Content tip
growth.tip.never: Nothing posted on {platform} yet. One short post this week beats a full plan on paper.
growth.tip.noRecent: Last post {n} days ago. The algorithm forgets fast; post something this week, even behind-the-scenes.
growth.tip.oneStage: {n} posts are all sitting at "{stage}". Move one of them a step forward today.
growth.tip.mix: Keep the length around {length} and alternate: a tutorial, a before/after, then behind-the-scenes.
growth.chart.empty: No points in the last 90 days
growth.chart.table: Show the numbers as a table
growth.history.title: Snapshot history
growth.history.empty: No numbers for this platform yet. Tap "Add numbers" above.
growth.history.confirmBody: This removes the {platform} numbers for {day}. You can type them again later.
growth.form.title: Add a day's numbers
growth.form.hint: Take the numbers from TikTok Studio, Instagram Insights or YouTube Studio. The same platform and day replaces the old entry.
growth.form.invalid: Check the numbers: followers and views are whole numbers, engagement is 0–100.
growth.form.future: Can't record numbers for a day that hasn't come yet.
growth.csv.title: Import stats CSV
growth.csv.hint: Paste the lines or pick a file. Each line: platform, day, followers, 30-day views, and engagement optional. Comma or ; both work; the header line is optional.
growth.csv.format: Example line (platform accepts tiktok/tt, instagram/ig, youtube/yt, threads/th, x, snapchat/sc):
growth.csv.where: Find the numbers in TikTok Studio → Analytics, Instagram Insights → Overview, and YouTube Studio → Analytics.
growth.asks.title: What people want
growth.asks.sub: Questions that keep coming up in comments and DMs. Tap +1 each time one repeats.
growth.asks.placeholder: e.g. How do I grade Log?
growth.asks.empty: No questions logged yet. When one repeats in the comments, write it here.
growth.asks.hint: These questions appear in the Ideas bank as ready post ideas.
